title: Chart quiz #10
caption:
Chart quiz #10. Three charts, three calls.

Q1: Uptrend, downtrend or range?
Q2: Continue, or reverse?
Q3: Will this new high hold?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #Trend #BullFlag #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Trends, flags and momentum. Question one. It's choppy, with some deep pullbacks. Is this an uptrend, a downtrend, or a range? An uptrend. Follow the swings, not the noise. Each high is higher than the last, and so is each low. Question two. A sharp rally, then a quiet drift lower on light volume. Does the move continue, or reverse? It reversed. It looked like a bull flag, but the drift kept going and broke the pole's base. Patterns fail too, which is why you'd use a stop. Question three. Price just made a new high. Now check the RSI panel underneath. Will this new high hold, or fail? It failed. Price made a higher high, but RSI made a lower one. That divergence showed momentum fading. It's a warning, not a certainty. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
